repeats.invalidReason: decode throughput collapsed to ~50% of the other four repeats (48 vs ~95 tok/s) — background scheduling contention on a non-quiesced dev machine; excluded from the decode aggregate, retained here in full.

notes: FIRST PocketRoofline measurement — M1 calibration anchor (not the M1 Pro used by RooflineBench; a lower same-family tier, reported as such). Run on macOS 27.0 dev machine, NOT quiescent and on charger, so this is a smoke-test of the pipeline and schema, not a steady-state figure: cooldown protocol (METHODOLOGY §5) was not applied and repeat 4's decode collapse reflects that. Prefill is stable (1653.8 avg, stddev 40.6). Decode across the 4 valid repeats: ~93 tok/s. thermalState here is asserted nominal (macOS does not expose per-run ProcessInfo.thermalState via llama-bench; the on-device iOS harness records it properly). ttftMs is the mean prefill wall time as a proxy. Purpose met: schema exercised end-to-end against real llama.cpp-Metal output before the device work begins.
